result.finding: Assessed 5 CWE rules in Credentials & Secrets: 1 FOUND, 4 NOT_FOUND
evidence: Full tracked application/configuration/Oracle scripts, Docker configuration, environment example and documentation credential patterns reviewed with values redacted. Runtime passwords are environment-injected and BCrypt is used for inbound credentials; sample placeholders and default usernames are not treated as active hard-coded passwords. No immutable cryptographic key found. Schema grants are scoped rather than DBA/ANY privileges. Public gallery reads are an explicitly documented policy, not an unintended access claim.

Limitations: no git-history secret scan, live environment values, file/volume ACL inspection, database grant verification or external proxy/SIEM log visibility. Tests/generated assessment artifacts excluded from CWE source findings. Credential literals are redacted; NOT_FOUND does not certify secrets are absent outside inspected scope.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Password
values.description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key
values.description: The product uses a hard-coded, unchangeable cryptographic key.

values.name: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
values.description: The product specifies permissions for a security-critical resource in a way that allows that resource to be read or modified by unintended actors.

values.name: Insufficient Logging

evidence.explanation: Security-critical photo upload and deletion logs record file/record identifiers and outcomes but omit authenticated principal and request source/correlation information. DetailController.deletePhoto and PhotoServiceImpl.uploadPhoto have no principal/request audit context; SecurityConfig configures HTTP Basic without an application audit handler or authentication-event log listener. Existing mutation logs cannot identify the requesting actor/source for investigation. This is insufficient audit context, not a claim that all application logging is absent; infrastructure access/audit logging was not supplied.

values.description: When a security-critical event occurs, the product either does not record the event or omits important details about the event when logging it.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
values.description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.
